why: Image 2's RGB-neon gyroscope pendant reads as a CG gaming prop and throws a blue-red cast onto the plaster wall, and the frame is softer and grainier overall, which makes it look like a filtered render. Image 1 has the same room with a dark mesh pendant that sits quietly in it and crisper wood, leather and plaster, though the hard daylight-like shafts on its right wall don't quite fit a night shoot.
